plugins.name: shipkit
plugins.description: 24 production-ready Claude Code skills that act like a senior dev team: review-branch, fix-bug, build-story, test-branch, audit-app (QA + UX), find-ux-gaps, grill-feature, refactor (with find-code-smells, apply-refactoring and design-pattern scorers), enforce-clean-architecture, deploy-to-vps, add-health-check, boost-seo, make-video, make-demo, write-user-guide, write-plainly, find-shared-code, show-usage and fill-timesheet. Stack-neutral; Windows, macOS and Linux.
